assertions.subject: Radial Neuropathy
assertions.quote: Wrist drop -The hand is flexed at the wrist and cannot be extended

assertions.subject: Radial Neuropathy
assertions.predicate: inability to extend the hand at the wrist
assertions.quote: A radial nerve lesion at any level above or in the forearm will cause an inability to extend the hand at the wrist

assertions.subject: High Median Neuropathy
assertions.quote: Hand of papal benediction (preacher's hand) - When the patient attempts to make a fist, the index and ring fingers remain extended

assertions.subject: High Median Neuropathy
assertions.quote: Some weakness of pronation may also occur due to loss of the pronator quadratus (anterior interosseous nerve), and pronator teres (high median neuropathy) due to a high median neuropathy before the anterior interosseous nerve is given off

assertions.subject: Radial Neuropathy
assertions.quote: If the posterior interosseous nerve alone is damaged, there will be a weak extension of the hand accompanied by radial deviation
